meta.label: NATIONWIDE POI PINS for the 3D catchment scene — MEASURED OSM establishment coordinates for all 11 scene pin types, bbox-filtered client-side so every province's 3D scene shows the same commercial fabric (not just curated Rayong).
meta.objective: Portfolio + acquisition (both): make each branch's 10 km commercial fabric legible in 3D for every province, not only the Rayong pilot.

provenance.coordinates: MEASURED — OpenStreetMap POI points (source-data/osm_layers.json, the 13-layer national Overpass pull; source items [lng,lat]). Swapped to [lat,lng] (the order the scene ColumnLayer expects) and rounded to 4 decimals (~11 m). NO synthesis, NO jitter, no fabricated points.
provenance.type_map: EDITORIAL — which OSM layer backs each of the scene's 11 pin types (meta.type_map); a 1:1 rename here, atm/civic excluded. The points themselves are measured; only this inclusion map is judgement.
provenance.vintage: osm_layers.json carries no internal timestamp; network vintage from platform/data/meta.json 'updated' = 2026M06 prices · drought 2026-06-21 (the enrichment-loop refresh that last pulled the layers).

meta.usage: the scene (rayong-catchment.html) loads this once and bbox-filters poi[type] to the current city's building extent — the SAME pattern it uses for competitors_national.json. Curated per-province .poi (Rayong) still wins when present.
meta.point_format: poi[<scene_type>] = [[lat,lng], ...], lat/lng rounded 4 dp; source order preserved (deterministic).

excluded_osm_layers.atm: the scene has no ATM pin type — ATMs ride under the 'bank' finance read already
excluded_osm_layers.civic: public-sector points; the scene has no civic pin type

gaps: OSM POI coverage is a sample/lower bound, not a registry — absence of a pin is NOT absence of an establishment.
Nationwide file (no per-province split); the scene bbox-filters it in the browser. Fine at this size (~1.4 MB); revisit if the POI pull grows much larger.
